title: Les DeMerle Band Comin' Home Baby CD 2016, Jazz - New Sealed
descriptionText: The Dynamic Les DeMerle Band's CD "Comin' Home Baby" is a sealed jazz album released in 2016 under the record label Origins Records. The album features uplifting and emotionally charged songs that showcase the band's talent and musicianship. With the CD sealed, music enthusiasts can enjoy a brand new listening experience from the convenience of their own home.
